basePrompts.r_as: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game inventory rune stone icon for a dark gothic top-down RPG; final used at 80px. Generate ONE isolated centered stone on true transparent alpha, square canvas. A flat upright palm-sized ancient slate tablet, height 75% canvas and width 58%, consistent six-sided silhouette: shallow angled shoulders, slightly rounded chipped corners, broad flat front face, shallow 3D bevel, upper-left light, worn rough gray stone, charcoal shadow edges. Front-facing with only a tiny right-side thickness, no tilt. Painterly old-school detailed game sprite with chunky controlled pixels and readable crisp edges, not smooth plastic, not photo. One LARGE deeply engraved pale chalk rune occupying central 48% face: a vertical stem with TWO upward diagonal branches at its top, like a three-pronged fork, plus one short horizontal foot below. Original fantasy glyph, no readable text. Bold strokes and dark inset grooves readable at 80px. Low-tier cool medium gray stone, pale bone-white cuts, NO glow. Entire object visible, centered with 12% empty padding, transparent outside silhouette, no ground shadow. No frames, scenery, symbols outside the tablet, words, letters, numbers, captions, watermarks, multiple objects or sheets.
basePrompts.waypoint_off: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent ground sprite for gothic top-down RPG. ONE isolated INACTIVE waypoint floor stone, true transparent alpha. Wide 8:5 canvas; a low circular stone disk seen obliquely from above, appearing as a horizontal ellipse ratio 1.6:1. Centered disk fills 84% width and 78% height, all edges fully visible, generous transparent margins. Rough charcoal gray carved stone, a very shallow chipped beveled edge, cracked ancient ring with 8 broad original rune marks, inner compass/star and double concentric circular engravings. Symmetric readable bold engravings, moderately detailed old-school hand-painted gritty game sprite, crisp silhouette; upper-left ambient lighting. The grooves are dull cool gray stone, UNLIT, absolutely no glow. This is an embedded floor slab that players walk on, NOT a portal doorway. No standing object, character, NPC, statue, sword, pedestal, pillars, surrounding ground tile, landscape, text, numbers, frame, watermarks or particles. Transparent background outside disk.
